import React from 'react';import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';import {BrowserRouter} from 'react-router-dom';import {HelmetProvider} from 'react-helmet-async';import App from './App';
ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<React.StrictMode><HelmetProvider><BrowserRouter><App/></BrowserRouter></HelmetProvider></React.StrictMode>);
